integrity: The proof is self-contained. Literature comparisons distinguish the upper closed-neighborhood parameter from minimum k-tuple and open-neighborhood total variants. Residual bibliographic risk from differently indexed older domination literature is disclosed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives the exact upper k-tuple domination number and an explicit family of extremal minimal sets, but not a complete classification of all extremal sets. Finite verification is limited to order 10 and is supplementary to the general proof.
title: Upper \(k\)-tuple domination of complete multipartite graphs
